product.name: Productivity Suite
product.description: A cloud-based platform to manage artist bookings, including contract negotiation, logistics, online payments, and revenue tracking.

product.name: Tour IQ
product.description: A searchable global database of venues and festivals to identify booking opportunities and key contacts.

product.name: Ticket Counts Pro
product.description: An automated system for collecting and analyzing ticket sales data with reporting and analytics.

product.name: Artist Essentials
product.description: A booking and tour management platform for self-managed artists including EPK, venue database, contracts, and payments.

product.name: Talent Buyer Pro
product.description: A venue management platform to streamline booking, manage workflows, contracts, payments, and reporting.
